minutes.summary: The Finance Committee held a public hearing on the special town meeting warrant, reviewing budget amendments, sewer, zoning and easement articles, and the TC Passios renovation or rebuild proposals. It then voted recommendations article by article, deferring several to a November 4 hearing. It also planned a tax-impact letter for the warrant and heard committee reports.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted unanimously to recommend approval of Articles A, B, E, F, G, I and J for the special town meeting.
It voted to defer its recommendation on Articles C and D, and on K and L until town meeting.
It found no financial impact on Article H and on Articles M, N, P, Q, R, S and T.
The committee agreed to hold a new public hearing on November 4 on deferred articles and to hear the TC Passios report that night.
A member will draft a tax-impact letter on Articles K and L, circulated by email for consensus before the select board votes on the warrant.

why_it_matters: Articles K and L, which the committee's tax-impact letter covers, and the TC Passios renovation or rebuild proposals could change a resident's tax bill, and the committee has not yet taken a position on K and L.

Article A's budget amendments, including town accountant hours and technology costs, are offset by lower health insurance and Monty Tech assessments and higher new growth, so the amended budget stays balanced.
watch_next: November 4 public hearing on the deferred articles, with the TC Passios report and the consent calendar on the agenda.
The committee's tax-impact letter on Articles K and L, due before the select board votes on the warrant.
